purpose: Verify removal of periodic idle reader wakeups; not a CPU/power benchmark
environment: Ubuntu 26.04 arm64 Docker in Colima VM on macOS/Apple M4; Xvfb 1280x900x24
extraction: Identify reader TID using prctl(PR_SET_NAME, "terminal-reader"); retain all its trace lines; count = 0 (Timeout) over the full trace, including startup. Child signals DSR barrier then sleeps three seconds and exits.

linux.emoji_raster_with_noto_color_emoji: passed in a separate targeted run after installing the font

tradeoffs: Two owned Unix socket descriptors per active reader
No CPU, battery or latency ratio inferred from one strace run
Reader still wakes for data, EOF, errors, signals or explicit cancellation; other application threads are outside this count
The after revision also includes merged text preservation/grapheme changes; this trace only validates removal of the reader timeout, not total performance between these revisions
after_environment_note: Noto Color Emoji installed before the final after trace; initial before trace used the package inventory in ../2026-09-10-modern-terminals/system-packages.txt
